root_cause_scalar_slow.bvh_type: BVH2 binary tree, recursive, scalar node tests
root_cause_scalar_slow.explanation: BVH2 tests 1 AABB per call. With ~9 levels and ~25-50 node visits per beam including recursion + cache, cost is ~35 ns/node. Embree uses BVH4/BVH8 (4-8 AABBs per SIMD instruction) at ~4 levels.

simd_bvh_estimates.rationale: BVH4 tests 4 child AABBs simultaneously; log4(440)~4.5 levels vs log2(440)~9; eliminates recursion. 2D geometry simpler than 3D (2 slab tests vs 3, ray-seg vs ray-triangle)
